29:46.text: And argue not with the people of the Scripture
(with good words and in good manner, inviting them to Islâmic Monotheism with His Verses)
, except with such of them as do wrong; and say
: "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you; our Ilâh
, and to Him we have submitted

29:47.text: And thus We have sent down the Book
, and those whom We gave the Scripture
believe therein as also do some of these
(who are present with you now like ‘Abdullâh bin Salâm)
and none but the disbelievers reject Our Ayât
[(proofs, signs, verses, lessons, etc.,) and deny Our Oneness of Lordship and Our Oneness of worship and Our Oneness of Our Names and Qualities: i.e. Islâmic Monotheism]

29:48.text: , nor did you write any book
with your right hand. In that case, indeed, the followers of falsehood might have doubted.

29:49.text: Nay, but they, the clear Ayât
[i.e. the description and the qualities of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم written in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)]
are preserved in the breasts of those who have been given knowledge
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)

29:50.text: And they say: "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord? Say: "The signs are only with Allâh, and I am only a plain warner."

29:51.text: Is it not sufficient for them that We have sent down to you the Book
which is recited to them? Verily, herein is mercy and a reminder

29:52.text: (to them O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
: "Sufficient is Allâh for a witness between me and you. He knows what is in the heavens and on earth." And those who believe in Bâtil
, it is they who are the losers.
